Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Sparks Debate and Box Office Success

Christopher Nolan's film adaptation of 'The Odyssey' has generated significant discussion and achieved substantial box office success in India. The film has drawn attention for its faithfulness to the original epic, with some critics and translators questioning its interpretation. Meanwhile, the movie has performed strongly commercially, surpassing ₹125 crore in India and becoming Nolan's highest-grossing film in the country. Universal Pictures is also reportedly taking action against online leaks of the film.
